verdict.rationale: Pigment is a planning platform, so bulk operations across many items is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents bulk editing, batch actions, or multi-item operations. Scheduled imports, model editing via MCP, and one-click scenarios are related features, not a documented bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
